name: Mojo’s Flight School
summary: Flight training school with course info and enrollment. Built to get new students booking intro flights.
together: Mojo needed a site that captured the fun of flying while making it dead simple to book an intro flight. We worked through the design together over a couple of quick rounds, and he had the final say on every page before it went live. One of my favorite builds — I fly paramotors myself, so this one was personal.
scope: Custom design & full development — no pre-made themes
aftercare: Security setup, 1-on-1 training, 2 months post-launch support
review: Dream Web nailed the vibe of our school on the first design. Students constantly tell us the site is what got them to book an intro flight.

name: Framework Accounting
summary: Construction accounting firm with a conversion-focused site that turns visitors into consultations.
together: The Framework team knew exactly who their clients were — construction owners tired of doing their own books. We shaped the messaging and design around that one reader, and refined it page by page until it felt right. They were a pleasure to work with from the first call to launch.
scope: Custom design & full development — no pre-made themes
aftercare: Security setup, 1-on-1 training, 2 months post-launch support
review: The site speaks directly to our clients and the consultation requests started coming in right after launch. Worth every penny.

name: Finesse by Whitney
summary: Dance-inspired strength training platform for women — a bold, high-energy site built to convert visitors into free-trial signups, with programs, pricing, and app downloads all one click away.
together: Whitney wanted her site to feel as polished as her training — strong, feminine, and easy to book. We tried a few directions for the look, she picked the one that felt most like her, and we refined it together page by page until launch.
scope: Custom design & full development — no pre-made themes
aftercare: Security setup, 1-on-1 training, 2 months post-launch support
review: The site feels exactly like the brand — bold, fun, and fast. Trial signups started rolling in the week we launched.

name: The Goods Vending
summary: Smart vending services with a bold, product-forward site.
together: The Goods team wanted a site as bold as their machines, and they trusted the process from day one. We locked the home page design in the first round of reviews, then rolled that energy through the rest of the site. Fast approvals made this one of the smoothest launches I’ve had.
scope: Custom design & full development — no pre-made themes
aftercare: Security setup, 1-on-1 training, 2 months post-launch support
review: Fast, professional, and easy to work with. The new site makes us look like the biggest vending company in the state.

name: Brian Apple
summary: Retirement planning site for a fiduciary advisor — built to move visitors from questions to a scheduled call, with an audiobook download and webinar signups capturing leads along the way.
together: Retirement planning is built on trust, so the site had to feel calm, credible, and easy to read. Brian and I worked through the copy and layout over a few short calls, and nothing went live until he was comfortable with every page.
scope: Custom design & full development — no pre-made themes
aftercare: Security setup, 1-on-1 training, 2 months post-launch support
review: The site explains what I do better than I ever could in person. Clients tell me it's why they felt comfortable reaching out.

name: Mentel Health
summary: Mental health care built for men — structured, clinically grounded, and designed to get visitors past the stigma and into care.
together: A mental health site has to feel safe before anything else. We kept the design soft and unhurried, wrote everything in plain language, and the Mentel team reviewed each page before it went live.
scope: Custom design & full development — no pre-made themes
aftercare: Security setup, 1-on-1 training, 2 months post-launch support
review: A sensitive subject handled with real care. The design feels strong and welcoming at the same time — exactly our brand.

name: Express Records
summary: Medical record retrieval service for injury law firms — built around transparency, integrations, and trust.
together: Express Records came to me with a clear vision and deep knowledge of their industry, which made this build a true collaboration. We refined the home page together until it clicked, then built out the rest page by page with same-week revisions. They still reach out for updates, and I’m always glad to jump back in.
scope: Custom design & full development — no pre-made themes
aftercare: Security setup, 1-on-1 training, 2 months post-launch support
review: Our old site confused people. This one walks every visitor straight to a request — exactly what we asked for.

name: Talize
summary: Thrift retail chain with weekly deals, donation info, and a store locator — a site as fun as the stores.
together: Talize came to me with a strong brand and a clear voice, and my job was to make the website live up to both. We shaped it section by section — deals, donations, impact — until it felt as energetic as their stores. Their team gave fast, decisive feedback, which made this a genuinely fun build.
scope: Custom design & full development — no pre-made themes
aftercare: Security setup, 1-on-1 training, 2 months post-launch support
review: The site captures the fun of our stores perfectly, and updates are simple enough that our team handles them in-house.
